column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Baal's confrontation and Gaius's armor awakening
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: It seems you had ample time to enjoy yourselves in this mansion while I was on my lunch break!
Did it meet your approval?!
Don't be ridiculous!
I mean, who are you... Wait,
Hey! Could you be...
That bastard $$バアル$$?!
So it was you...!!
You cannot escape now!!
Hand over the $$大邪神$$ armor, and tell us where you've taken my daughter!
Hand over the $$大邪神$$ armor, and tell us where you've taken them!
Very well!
That is, if you can defeat me now that I am full...!
But it seems they themselves wish to fight you first!!
Now, kill them!
Forgive us. If we don't kill you, our families...
$$バアル$$ has taken our precious families hostage!!
I don't want to die yet...
If we defy Lord $$バアル$$, we can't live in this city!
My... my son!
Why? Why won't you fight back?!
For the sake of those dear to you,
I understand all too painfully how you can be ready to lay down your lives!
That's why I can't kill you!!
But then you'll...!
Yeah, you don't need to throw your life away here!!
Everyone, stop!!
Please, don't kill them!
This may indeed be the hypocrisy in me,
but I have to save them!
Heh heh heh heh...
This is why people who believe in the power of $$邪神$$s are called foolish $$邪教徒$$s!!
All this talk of $$正義$$, all this talk of $$平等$$.
Believing in things that never existed anywhere in $$この世$$,
and even throwing away their lives to save worthless $$奴隷$$s!
Even though those people no longer have any will of their own.
What?!
With beautiful terror in tow,
cross the river of $$血$$ in the underworld,
O dark life offered to $$大神サタン$$,
become crimson dead, and show forth the power of Hades!!
Aaaaghhhhhhh!!
Death to those who defy me!!
Ha ha ha ha ha!!
As I thought, they had already become $$血$$-drinking vampires!
What do we do?! They're trying to attack indiscriminately!
They can no longer be restored! Killing them is the only way to save them!!
No.
Truly, killing $$バアル$$ would be quickest, but...
Unless we defeat them, it looks like we can't attack him.
No.
Can't be helped. We'll do it!
Nooooo!!
What?!
Idiot! What do you think you're doing?!
“$$ガイ$$ puts on the armor”
Oh!!
Even he... bears the $$邪神$$'s light?!
Me too... am I qualified to wear this armor?!
The power... to save them...
If it will give me that...
Then... I'll put it on...
Even if this body... withers away!
A miracle...
I-impossible! I refuse to accept it, absolutely never!
There must never be a human who harbors a sham like $$正義$$ in their heart!!
Come out!!
Kill every last one of them!!
